quote: And did you get what / you wanted from this life, even so? / I did. / And what did you want? / To call myself beloved, to feel myself / beloved on the earth.
source: Raymond Carver, Late Fragment, the whole poem, A New Path to the Waterfall (Atlantic Monthly Press, 1989)
